headline: Approved February 2026 minutes and reimbursement, elected interim chair amid quorum concerns from departing members.
summary: The committee approved February 2026 minutes and a $110 reimbursement to Carole for copies and name tags, both by 6-0 votes. Several members are terming out, leaving the committee unable to meet quorum until seats are filled or quorum rules change, so Eric was elected interim chair 6-0. The committee also reviewed upcoming community events and discussed a possible ordinance change to adjust quorum rules.
decisions: Motioned to reimburse Carole $110 for copies and name tags, motion passed 6-0.
Motioned to establish an interim chair until the quorum issue is resolved, motion passed 6-0.
Nominated and elected Eric as interim chair, motion passed 6-0.
